reason: Symlink-based arbitrary temp-file write (GHSA-52f5-9888-hmc6), reached only through @stryker-mutator/core's optional interactive 'external editor' prompt (inquirer/editor). Gate 17/5 invoke `stryker run` non-interactively in CI and locally; that code path is never entered. Exposure requires a local attacker who can already plant a symlink at a predictable temp path before an operator manually chooses the interactive editor flow.
Path traversal via unsanitized prefix/postfix (GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65), same transitive path and same non-interactive-CI reasoning as 1109537 above.

Path traversal in optimized-deps .map handling (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9) — a `vite dev`-server-only request-handling bug. This pipeline never runs `vite dev`; CI only runs `vite build` and `vite preview` against a build already produced from trusted source, and the fix requires a Vite 6+ major bump not yet scheduled.

launch-editor NTLMv2 hash disclosure on Windows (GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3) — dev-server-only, Windows-only, and triggered by opening a file in an external editor from the dev server's error overlay. This template's CI runs on Linux runners and never starts the dev server.
server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate data streams (GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff) — dev-server-only, Windows-only; same reasoning as 1120784.
